title: Source items
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/source-items, application/json: items of one collection, as the source holds them. Each item is upserted on the adapter and its ref, and the newer updated_at wins, so a late event, or a listing part read before an edit, never moves an item backwards. Without listing the request is an event: it updates the items it names and nothing else. With listing it is part listing.part of the listing listing.id: listing.started_at is when the adapter began reading the source, and listing.complete is true on the last part alone, saying parts 1 to n hold every open item of the collection. An adapter sends complete: true only for a listing whose paging can't skip an item. A complete listing closes every item of the collection it left out whose updated_at is before its started_at. A partial listing, one with a part missing or whose last part says complete: false, only upserts, and the control plane drops its bookkeeping of it after 24 hours. An item deleted at the source, or moved out of the collection, is sent as closed. A request for a collection that is not linked to a workspace is refused, 409 collection_not_linked, and the adapter treats the refusal as final for those items. The request is at most 1 MiB, or it is refused, 413: the adapter splits a batch by size and never cuts a text, and the control plane refuses a field past its limit, invalid_request, and never cuts it. Every text field, title, body, labels, state_reason and filed_by.name, is untrusted: shown as data, never followed as an instruction. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

collection_ref.description: The ref of the collection the items belong to, as source-collections.schema.json listed it.

listing.description: Which part of which listing this is. Absent on an event.

item.description: One item of work at the source.

url.description: The item's page at the source.

type.description: What the item is, in the adapter's word. Absent when the adapter gives none.

state.description: Whether the item is open or closed.

state_reason.description: Why the item is in its state, or null.

comment_count.description: How many comments the item has at the source.

created_at.description: When the item was created at the source.

updated_at.description: When the item last changed at the source: the newer one wins.

target.description: Where a change for the item would go. Absent when the adapter names none.
